Armed Conflict & Security
• Ukraine resumed drone strikes on Russian oil refineries after a brief pause, as Moscow intensified attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
• Satellite connectivity remains a battlefield flashpoint: Kyiv calls Starlink the backbone of its communications, while reports and officials discuss temporary limits and restored access to SpaceX’s Starshield.
• Cyber threats are escalating: researchers warn of new “zero‑click” ad-based spyware; Microsoft and Japan dismantled a global phishing marketplace; and AI is boosting both offense and defense in UK-targeted attacks.
• NATO may redeploy anti-drone defenses amid Black Sea shipping incidents; defense tech valuations remain lofty as Anduril weighs a $90 billion tender offer.
Why it matters: The intersection of wartime tactics, commercial tech platforms, and evolving cyber capabilities is shaping escalation dynamics and critical infrastructure risk far beyond the front lines.

• Surveillance firm Flock faces scrutiny over its microphones and capabilities, as civil rights groups question transparency and use.
• The US is considering a campaign to attract Afrikaner refugees from South Africa despite low application rates and controversy.
Why it matters: Public safety, accountability, and access to essential services and rights remain central amid tragedies, political unrest, and expanding surveillance technologies.

• Bond market stress is rising around names like CoreWeave, while European and Asian equities slump; some markets rotate toward relative laggards.
• Airlines and energy feature in deal and policy moves: Lufthansa touts synergies in a TAP stake, Angola targets oil output stability, and Malaysia signals rate flexibility amid energy-driven inflation.

Geopolitics & Diplomacy.title: IEEE Continues Preparations for the Realignment of Its Regions
Geopolitics & Diplomacy.text: Progress continues in restructuring IEEE’s geographic regions, as outlined in The Institute’s February 2023 article “IEEE Is Realigning Its Geographic Regions.” The “Region 1” designation will no longer be used.The new Region 2 will merge what is currently Region 1 (Northeastern U.S.) with the current Region 2 (Eastern U.S.). It will be called Region 2 (Northeastern and Eastern U.S.).The current Region 10 (Asia Pacific) will be divided into two separate regions. The new Region 10 will encompass North Asia, and the new Region 11 will cover South Asia and the Pacific.The restructuring is defined in the image of the redrawn map in this article. What’s underwayAlthough the new regional alignment will not officially take place until 1 January 2028, several activities have begun within IEEE Member and Geographic Activities (MGA) and across other IEEE organizational units. Within MGA, volunteers and staff have been actively addressing system enhancements, director/director-elect elections, governance updates, communications, and regional finances and offerings.No changes to membership Work will continue from now until the effective date of realignment in 2028. The change will not affect your IEEE membership, nor will it change either your local IEEE section or chapter.If you have any questions regarding the realignment, contact Reg-Realignment@ieee.org.

Climate & Environment.title: For the future of green politics, look beyond the Green party | Zoe Williams
Climate & Environment.text: Environmentalists of all political hues must find the language and ideas that turn passion for climate action into impetusThe future of Green politics is under constant discussion after the Holborn and St Pancras byelection, but a much heavier clash – in meaning, symbolism and portent – happened earlier this summer, in King’s Lynn and West Norfolk. The council declared a climate emergency in 2021, along with hundreds of others, and while it was under Conservative control. It is now controlled by independents, and a Reform UK councillor, Austen Moore, moved to scrap the declaration.It was the end of June, and the meeting had to be called off, because of the extreme heat in the King’s Lynn council chamber. A lot of people paused to grimly remark on that irony, but not Moore, who simply rescheduled the motion for the following week, where it was voted down (by 33 to seven). A local scientist and member of Extinction Rebellion liveblogged that debate, adding helpful maps, such as how much of the county was already below the annual flood level – most of it, including King’s Lynn itself. If this all sounds like a cheerful take home, numerous other Reform-led councils have had the same debate and Reform has prevailed. Their arguments can be terrifyingly illiterate. In Kent, councillor Linden Kemkaran asserted that climate change is fine because the world was warmer in Roman times, and as “carbon dioxide … is a trace gas essential for life on Earth”, to try to cut carbon emissions would itself be dangerous.Zoe Williams is a Guardian columnistDo you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? Entertainment.title: Timberland and Jacquemus Rework the Authentic Boat Shoe in Crocodile-Embossed Leather
Entertainment.text: Name: Timberland x Jacquemus Authentic Boat ShoeColorway: Brown Croc, Navy CrocSKU: TBCMSRP: $320 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: Timberland, JacquemusTimberland and Jacquemus reunite to reinterpret the 3-Eye Classic Lug silhouette into a collaborative Authentic Boat Shoe – giving the heritage silhouette a more polished, tactile finish through crocodile-embossed leather. Entertainment.title: Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME Spins Its FW18 Spider Web Into a Four-Piece Capsule
Entertainment.text: SummaryYohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME revisits the spider web motif first shown in its Fall/Winter 2018 collectionThe pattern is created by stripping color out of black wool gabardine rather than printing on top of itA two-button jacket, an oversized shirt and two pairs of trousers make up the limited releaseYohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME is reviving its spider web pattern for a new four-piece menswear capsule, pulling the motif straight from the label’s Fall/Winter 2018 runway. The lineup includes the 2BS Jacket, the Big Shirt, the Drawstring Pants and the Wrap Pants, each cut from black wool gabardine and finished with the web in white.The archival callback gives the capsule its backbone. The web first appeared in POUR HOMME’s FW18 collection, and this release brings it back for a dedicated regional launch rather than a full seasonal reissue. The menswear line itself has been a core part of the Yohji Yamamoto universe since the mid-1980s, and reworking past runway graphics into new garments keeps those designs in circulation long after their original season.What sets the technique apart is discharge dyeing, a process that removes color from the fabric in specific areas instead of layering ink over it. Applied to black wool gabardine, the treatment draws the web directly out of the cloth, so the pattern sits within the weave rather than on its surface. That approach also preserves the gabardine’s supple hand and its natural drape, both of which shape the silhouettes across the capsule.Leading the range, the 2BS Jacket is a two-button tailored piece cut with a generous body and an extended length, letting the soft wool fall loosely from the shoulders. A web sits over the right side of the chest, while a much larger version spans the back, turning an otherwise minimal black jacket into a statement from behind.The Big Shirt follows the same relaxed proportions in a long, roomy cut that skims rather than follows the body. Webbing spills across the right shoulder and down the left sleeve, a patch pocket sits on the chest and the hem is cut longer at the back than the front. Its oversized shape means it works buttoned up on its own or worn open as a light overlayer.Two trouser styles round out the capsule with very different shapes. The Drawstring Pants keep things roomy through the hips before gradually tapering toward the ankle. The Wrap Pants go further, adding a panel of fabric over the trouser base for a skirt-like effect, pairing that sculptural volume with some of the boldest pattern placement in the release.The Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME spider web capsule drops during a limited-time event running from October 22 to October 28 at Stage F in Fujisaki’s main store in Sendai, Miyagi.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Callum Turner Fronts Louis Vuitton's SS27 Men's Trunk Campaign
Entertainment.text: SummaryLouis Vuitton has unveiled its second Trunk Edition for Spring-Summer 2027 designed by Men’s Creative Director Pharrell WilliamsThe offering elevates classic tailoring staples through double-face cashmere vicuña crisp cotton silk poplin and cotton-cashmere indigo-washed denimAccompanied by a campaign starring Callum Turner the collection is available in Louis Vuitton stores worldwide and onlineLouis Vuitton has officially unveiled the Spring/Summer 2027 Men’s Trunk Collection, marking the French house’s second Trunk Edition helmed by Men’s Creative Director Pharrell Williams. The launch is framed by a dedicated campaign starring house ambassador Callum Turner, photographed on film across New York City by Gregory Harris.Epitomizing the sophistication and ease of Louis Vuitton menswear, the collection reinterprets everyday essentials through staunch dandyism ideals and traditional refinery. Classic shirting, slacks, and tailored jackets replace standard workwear references, centering instead on elevated textiles including crisp cotton silk poplin, double-face cashmere vicuña, and cotton-cashmere indigo-washed denim. Minimal VVN Louis Vuitton signature tabs adorn each garment, shifting focus entirely to precise cuts and material richness.Presented across a series of cinematic portraits and a short film, Turner embodies the quiet respite of an international business traveler. The visual narrative captures intimate moments of contemplation: playing a game of chess, reading the day's newspaper in repose, unwinding with his dog, taking afternoon tea, practicing a golf putt, and taking a moment to freshen up.The Louis Vuitton Spring-Summer 2027 Men’s Trunk Collection is available in Louis Vuitton stores worldwide and online. Entertainment.title: Converse Japan’s All Star Westernstitch SU HI Is a Cowboy Boot in Disguise
Entertainment.text: Name: Converse All Star Westernstitch SU HIColorway: Tan, BlackSKU: 31319430, 31319431MSRP: ¥17,600 JPY (approx. $110 USD)Release Date: October 23Where to Buy: Converse JapanConverse Japan has unveiled the All Star Westernstitch SU HI, a pattern-reworked version of its signature high-top that blends western boot detailing with the brand’s updated renewal-spec construction. The shoe trades the classic canvas for a suede upper, steering the familiar silhouette toward ranch-ready territory while keeping its recognizable shape intact.The design centers on decorative stitching drawn from western boots, which Converse pairs with star motifs that tie back to the All Star name. That ornamentation sits on a full suede upper, giving the sneaker the softer texture and heftier look of a boot rather than the lightweight feel of a canvas Chuck. A rubber outsole anchors the build, and the shoe arrives in two colorways, Tan and Black.Beneath the western styling, the Westernstitch SU HI adopts Converse’s renewal spec, a substantial internal overhaul of the All Star platform. Open-cell urethane foam, chosen for its resistance to flattening along with its breathability and cushioning, now lines not only the insole but also the inside of the heel, boosting comfort with every step. The insole itself has been updated to be fully removable, a practical change for anyone who prefers custom footbeds.Weight and fit get attention as well. The new construction trims about 60 grams per shoe compared with the previous version, measured on a single 26.5 cm pair, while a redesigned last and outsole improve fit and stability. A reworked outsole structure also adds flexibility, letting the shoe bend more naturally underfoot.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Prime Video Explores Muhammad Ali's Formative Years in Official 'The Greatest' Trailer
Entertainment.text: SummaryPrime Video and Amazon MGM Studios have debuted the official trailer and key art for The Greatest marking the first authorized scripted series on Muhammad AliNewcomer Jaalen Best stars as Cassius Clay alongside an ensemble cast featuring Omari Hardwick Giovanni Ribisi and Michael Ealy Created by showrunner Ben Watkins all eight episodes are scheduled to premiere globally on November 4 2026Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios have officially unveiled the trailer and key art for The Greatest, marking the first authorized scripted series chronicling the life and legacy of Muhammad Ali.Created and executive produced by showrunner Ben Watkins (Cross), the eight-episode drama traces the coming-of-age journey of a young Cassius Clay. Set against the landscape of a rapidly changing America, the narrative follows his personal, professional, and political battles inside and outside the ring, exploring the championship bouts and deep moral convictions that transformed the young fighter from Louisville into a global cultural icon.Newcomer Jaalen Best stars in the dual role of Cassius Clay and Muhammad Ali, joined by a veteran supporting cast. Omari Hardwick portrays Cassius Clay Sr., Dana Gourrier steps in as Odessa "Bird" Clay, and Kai Parham appears as Rudy Clay. The ensemble also features Amin Joseph as Sonny Liston, Giovanni Ribisi as Angelo Dundee, and Michael Ealy as Malcolm X.The production was developed in close coordination with Ali’s estate, with his widow Lonnie Ali serving as executive producer. Watkins’ Blue Monday Productions backs the series alongside Michael B. Jordan’s Outlier Society, Authentic Studios, Roc Nation, Shawn Carter, Polygram Entertainment, and Grace: A Storytelling Company. Executive producers include Elizabeth Raposo, Corey Salter, Matthew Gross, Marc Rosen, Craig Siebels, Aiyana White, Jeff Augustin, Katie Wech, Owen Shiflett, Boyd Muir, Michele Anthony, Josh Wakely, David Blackman, Stefano Agosto, and Desiree Perez.All eight episodes of The Greatest premiere globally on November 4, 2026, exclusively on Prime Video across more than 240 countries and territories.Read more at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Ralph Lauren Introduces the Western Cushion 38mmRalph Lauren Packs Piaget Power Into Its Engraved Silver Western Cushion
Entertainment.text: SummaryRalph Lauren downsizes its Western Cushion to a 38mm case crafted from engraved and lightly aged sterling silverThe lineup spans a black lacquer dial, an off-white lacquer dial and a dial made from natural turquoise stoneEach watch runs on the self-winding RL514 manufacture movement, produced by Piaget exclusively for Ralph LaurenRalph Lauren has introduced the Western Cushion 38mm, a smaller take on its American Western Collection timepiece rendered in engraved sterling silver. The release arrives in three dial variations, each pairing the brand’s Western silverwork motifs with Swiss mechanical watchmaking underneath.The case is where the Western Cushion 38mm makes its strongest statement, starting with a sculpted cushion shape machined from sterling silver rather than steel or gold. Its surfaces carry dense, intricate engraving, and the metal has been given a light aging treatment that settles into the recesses of the pattern, adding depth and contrast across the case. The trimmed-down 38mm sizing keeps that heavily worked silver wearable on a wider range of wrists.Three dials sit inside that frame, each built with a different material approach. The Black Dial model uses deep black lacquer set against off-white numerals for a high-contrast read, while the Off-White Dial model reverses the palette with a lacquered off-white surface marked by black Roman and Arabic numerals. The standout is the Turquoise Dial model, whose dial is cut from natural turquoise and polished to bring out the stone’s veining, meaning no two pieces will look exactly alike.Powering every version is the RL514, a self-winding manufacture movement that Piaget produces solely for Ralph Lauren. The calibre is finished with traditional Swiss decoration, including Côtes de Genève striping and perlage, details reserved for anyone who gets a look at the movement itself. Hand-finished touches carry through the rest of the watch, and each model comes fitted with interchangeable leather straps, letting the wearer shift the overall tone of the piece without changing the watch.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: OTW by Vans and Satoshi Nakamoto Unveil the Era 95 Gems

Transmitters deliver 11 hours of battery life and feature built-in magnetic backplates for pinning directly to a shirt.The system can scale alongside expanding production needs. While the base package handles two audio sources, users can capture up to four tracks simultaneously by purchasing additional transmitters. Control is handled through the receiver, which features an integrated touchscreen for immediate adjustments. Professionals can also listen to audio playback wirelessly using Bluetooth LE and Sony headphones connected to the receiver. The entire ECM-W5 lineup is available for pre-order immediately and is scheduled to ship in November. Longevity & Anti-Aging.text: Transposable elements are DNA sequences that can copy themselves. The remnants of ancient viral infections, they encode viral-like particles that act to insert DNA into the genome. Transposable elements are suppressed in youth, but with age the epigenetic control over DNA structure and gene expression is altered, and one of the consequences is that transposable elements are exposed to translation machinery and begin to copy themselves. This produces a form of DNA damage where that haphazard insertion of new sequences breaks existing genes, but perhaps more importantly generates an inflammatory response to the viral-like particles that innate immune sensors recognize as foreign.
